# We make the subsurface clearer.

<p class="lead">SEEM develops computational methods for sensing, monitoring, imaging, and interpreting the Earth—connecting geoscience, signal processing, and scientific machine learning.</p>

::: {.section-band}
::: {.section-intro}
## Four connected research themes

We combine practical Earth observations with reproducible computational research, from field-scale monitoring to transparent geological interpretation.
:::

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
<div class="feature-number">01 · SIGNAL</div>

### Monitoring & microseismicity

Detection, characterization, and localization of seismic events.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
<div class="feature-number">02 · SENSING</div>

### DAS & VSP analysis

Signal processing and deep learning for distributed acoustic sensing observations.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
<div class="feature-number">03 · COMPUTATION</div>

### Scientific machine learning

Neural operators and physics-informed learning for inverse problems and reconstruction.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
<div class="feature-number">04 · INSIGHT</div>

### Geological interpretation

Explainable AI and reconstruction tools for transparent subsurface interpretation.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.section-band .soft}
::: {.section-intro}
## Selected work

The website explains why each result matters; GitHub remains the technical source of truth.
:::

::: {.project-grid}
::: {.project-card}
<!-- Prototype status option retained: <span class="status-chip">Prototype project card</span> -->

### SeisReconNO

A U-Net-enhanced Fourier neural operator approach for reconstructing missing traces in 3D seismic data.

<span class="tag">Neural operators</span><span class="tag">3D seismic</span><span class="tag">Open source</span>

::: {.card-actions}
[Project story](projects/seisreconno.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
[GitHub](https://github.com/SEEM-KFUPM/SeisReconNO){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### Explainable PhaseNet

Grad-CAM and SHAP tools for interpreting PhaseNet and improving microseismic event detection under strong noise.

<span class="tag">Explainable AI</span><span class="tag">Event detection</span><span class="tag">Open source</span>

::: {.card-actions}
[Project story](projects/xai-phasenet.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
[GitHub](https://github.com/SEEM-KFUPM/xAI_PhaseNet){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::

::: {.project-card}
### GeoSIRR

Conversational generation, validation, refinement, and visualization of geological cross-sections.

<span class="tag">Geological modeling</span><span class="tag">LLMs</span><span class="tag">Open source</span>

::: {.card-actions}
[Project story](projects/geosirr.qmd){.btn .btn-sm .btn-primary}
[GitHub](https://github.com/SEEM-KFUPM/GeoSIRR){.btn .btn-sm .btn-outline-primary}
:::
:::
